answers.core: This method provides functionality to create amazing add-ons, but its implementation depends on things only available in the core, like access to the SVG parser and rasterizer library (nanosvg).
answers.workaround:
No, we can load **SVGs** from file at runtime with [Image::load](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_image.html#class-image-method-load), but there is no option to load it at different scales, the scale 1.0 is implicit and cannot be modified.

**Edit**: According to https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3422#issuecomment-942560151, **SVG** is only available in editor builds, so even the [Image::load](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_image.html#class-image-method-load) won't work for exported projects.

title: Add a way to load SVG files from buffer at an adjustable scale
